stem: 一家赌场的合规部门正在审查近期的交易，并已发现了一些可能需要进一步调查的活动。哪笔交易需要进一步调查？

options.A: 一位常去赌场的赌客，每次存入少量现金，却总是要求将赢来的钱换成大额支票提现
options.B: 一群游客用信用卡购买筹码，参与高额赌局，然后套现
options.C: 一名玩家使用现金和从国际账户通过电汇转入的5万美元购买筹码，但并未参与赌博，随后将筹码全部提现
options.D: 偶尔光顾的玩家，使用与国外账户关联的预付借记卡玩低注额的游戏

stem_en: The compliance department of a casino is reviewing recent transactions and has identified activities that may require further scrutiny. Which transaction would require further investigation?

options_en.A: A patron who regularly visits the casino, deposits small amounts of cash, and consistently requests to cash out winnings in high-value checks
options_en.B: A group of tourists who buy chips with credit cards and engage in high-stakes games before cashing out
options_en.C: A player who purchases USD 50,000 in chips using a combination of cash and a wire transfer from an international account, does not gamble, and then cashes out
options_en.D: An occasional visitor who plays low-stakes games using a prepaid debit card linked to a foreign account
